component: Appearance accent-color preference and theme consumers

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accent menu stores OS-following or named palette values in mail.appearance.accentColor. Outside contrast mode, custom media branches override selected-item color and text tokens used by actual primary-button and tabline consumers. The test asserts a purple preference and tabline/swatch background equality, then restores the OS choice. It does not measure every palette, theme interaction or accessibility contrast. Accepted native accent-color CSS and later selector/label changes are separate phases.
title: The Appearance accent selector stores a named preference and overrides shared selection tokens
